bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
test "$(realpath "$root")" = /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot || exit 70
stage="$root/.worktrees/userbot-profile-topics-f711"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 2a57653896161eed36b0c97d598a3ee9670259a5 || exit 71
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 72
python3 - "$root" "$stage" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys,os,ast,stat
root,stage=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
p=root/"scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
original=p.read_text()
source=(stage/"scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py").read_text()
begin='    if action == "profile_topics_by_id":'
end='    if action == "profile_topics_readback":'
if original.count(begin)!=2 or source.count(begin)!=1 or original.count(end)!=1 or source.count(end)!=1:sys.exit(80)
a_end=original.index(end)
a=original.rfind(begin,0,a_end)
x_end=source.index(end)
x=source.rfind(begin,0,x_end)
if a<0 or x<0 or "GetForumTopicsByIDRequest" not in original[a:a_end]:sys.exit(81)
newblock=source[x:x_end]
if "GetForumTopicsRequest" not in newblock:sys.exit(82)
merged=original[:a]+newblock+original[a_end:]
if 'PROFILE_TOPIC_SCAN_CURSOR_INVALID' not in merged:
 if merged.count('"PROFILE_TOPIC_IDS_INVALID",')!=1:sys.exit(83)
 merged=merged.replace('"PROFILE_TOPIC_IDS_INVALID",',
   '"PROFILE_TOPIC_IDS_INVALID", "PROFILE_TOPIC_SCAN_CURSOR_INVALID", "PROFILE_TOPIC_SCAN_LIMIT_REACHED",',1)
ast.parse(merged)
backup=stage/"live_userbot_resident_ipc_before_f716.py"
if backup.exists() or backup.is_symlink():sys.exit(84)
backup.write_text(original)
backup.chmod(0o600)
tmp=root/"scripts/.userbot_resident_ipc.f716.tmp"
if tmp.exists() or tmp.is_symlink():sys.exit(85)
mode=stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)
fd=os.open(tmp,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,"w",encoding="utf8") as h:
 h.write(merged);h.flush();os.fsync(h.fileno())
os.chmod(tmp,mode)
os.replace(tmp,p)
print("INSTALLED_TELETHON_TOPIC_LOOKUP_SURGICAL_PATCH_PASS")
PY
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-userbot-verify.service || exit 73
echo USERBOT_HANDLER_READY_FOR_CONTROLLED_CODE_ACTIVATION
